tickets.title: Start retirement plan rollover
tickets.text: Prepare the Silver Marmot Laboratories 401(k) rollover for Nadia Copperwisp after her September 2024 separation, including account registration and the company-stock portion valued at approximately $347,000 (38% of $914,000).
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-06 to start preparing the Silver Marmot Laboratories 401(k) move after separation, including receiving account registration and company-stock portion.

tickets.title: Obtain formal pension election packet by August 23
tickets.text: Obtain the formal pension election packet for Nadia Copperwisp from Silver Marmot Laboratories by August 23, 2024, because only portal estimates are currently available for her single-life and joint-and-survivor pension options.
tickets.evidence: By 2024-08-23, the formal pension election packet is needed because only portal estimates were available.

tickets.title: Review first-year retirement income and withholding
tickets.text: Review first-year retirement income and withholding for Nadia Copperwisp, incorporating her final paycheck, unused vacation payout, and first pension payment timing into the tax projection before her September 2024 retirement.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-13 to review first-year retirement income and withholding because Tobin noted final paycheck, unused vacation payout, and first pension timing were not yet in the tax projection.
